name: customer-support
summary: Support agents refund Stripe payments in test mode: an approver releases refunds above 50.00 USD, refunds above 100.00 USD are refused, and the agent's grant refunds at most 500.00 USD a week.
protects: every refund above 50.00 USD waits for an independent approver
no refund above 100.00 USD is made, approved or not
the agent's grant refunds at most 500.00 USD a week (its budget)
a refund never exceeds what is left to refund on the payment, read from Stripe within the last 60 seconds
the agent's grant covers creating and reading refunds and reading payments only
excludes: ticket updates and replies to the customer: M14 has no write connector for the ticket system
refunds in currencies other than USD: the rules fail closed (CANNOT_AUTHORIZE) until you add rules for them
whether a refund is justified: the approver decides from the payment and the reason the agent gives
refunds made outside PantherClaw (the Stripe dashboard, another integration, a person with the API key) are not seen or limited
Stripe live mode: pc.stripe refuses live keys
the thresholds are examples: change them in a new policy version before relying on them
grant: creating refunds on Stripe payments, reading refunds and payments; 500.00 USD of refunds a week

connections: a pc.stripe connection with a restricted test key in enforce mode, which also provides the fact stripe.payment.refundable
